milestones.title: NASA Launches Voyager 1 Space Probe
milestones.fact: Equipped with the iconic Golden Record and cutting-edge 1970s digital computers, Voyager 1 launched to explore interstellar space. Today, it remains the farthest human-made object in the cosmos.

milestones.title: Google Releases Chrome Beta 0.2
milestones.fact: Google unveiled the first public beta of the Chrome browser, introducing the revolutionary V8 JavaScript engine that transformed web application performance forever.

milestones.title: Google.com Domain Registered
milestones.fact: Larry Page and Sergey Brin officially registered the domain Google.com, paving the way for modern algorithmic search and digital indexing.
